name: eternities-herald
intent: Govern local release lifecycle, delivery design, production readiness, and dependency-name screening without crossing external release effects.
successCondition: One route produces a verified local release artifact or a bounded refusal or handoff with evidence, authority, risk, and effect boundaries explicit.
inputs: authorized release objective and repository evidence
change, pipeline, runtime, dependency, authority, risk, and acceptance context
outputs: local release plan, delivery design, readiness packet, dependency screening, refusal, or specialist handoff
exact evidence lineage, assumptions, unknowns, gates, proposed effects, and human decision ownership
operations: select one route from exact evidence
separate local work from external effects
positiveTriggers: triage verified changes into an auditable release boundary
design repository-aware continuous delivery gates and stages
prepare production readiness and rollback evidence
screen a dependency name for namespace impersonation before install
negativeTriggers: push a tag or mutate a repository or registry
install a package or accept a lockfile
use credentials or make an external write
unresolved authority, risk, or current platform facts
failureModes: evidence or source lineage is missing or stale
approval, authority, risk, migration, health, or rollback condition is unresolved
requested effect is deployment, publication, tag push, installation, credential use, or external write
package identity remains ambiguous or resembles a protected namespace
route ownership or specialist boundary is unclear
